functions.name: palette
functions.description:
Retrieves a color from the UXDSL theme palette.

Example: `color: palette(primary-main);`

functions.name: space
functions.description:
Retrieves a spacing value from the UXDSL theme.

Example: `padding: space(4);`

functions.name: density
functions.description:
Retrieves a density-aware spacing value.

Example: `margin: density(4);` may resolve, according to thme def. to `margin: xs(space(4) md(space(5) lg(space(6)));`

functions.name: radius
functions.description:
Retrieves a border-radius value from the UXDSL theme.

Example: `border-radius: radius(md);`

functions.name: typography
functions.description:
Applies a responsive typography variant's styles.

Example: `font: typography(h1);` may resolve to `font-size: xs(1.5rem) md(2rem);` according to the theme definition.

functions.name: xs
functions.description:
Applies styles only at the 'xs' breakpoint and up.

Example: `width: xs(100%);`

functions.name: sm
functions.description:
Applies styles only at the 'sm' breakpoint and up.

Example: `width: sm(50%);`

functions.name: md
functions.description:
Applies styles only at the 'md' breakpoint and up.

Example: `width: md(33%);`

functions.name: lg
functions.description:
Applies styles only at the 'lg' breakpoint and up.

Example: `width: lg(25%);`

functions.name: xl
functions.description:
Applies styles only at the 'xl' breakpoint and up.

Example: `width: xl(20%);`
